vehicle: 1984 Toyota Land Cruiser FJ40 · 4.2L 2F inline-six · 4-speed · built in Nagoya
status: Head out for machining (valve job). Engine apart in the garage.

items.title: Head at the machine shop
items.note: 4 of 6 exhaust valves burned before 500 km on the advertised rebuild. Casting salvageable; valve job rather than a replacement head. Ask the shop: valve lash as found, new vs old valves and seats, cracks or warp.

items.title: Carburetor runs lean
items.note: Root cause of the burnt valves. Re-jet or replace before the head goes back on; check the intake manifold gasket for a vacuum leak (known 2F failure).

items.title: No thermostat installed
items.note: Another corner cut in the rebuild. Fit one on reassembly.

items.title: GL-4 only
items.note: Never GL-5 in the 4-speed: it eats the brass synchros.

items.title: GR Auto Gallery dispute
items.note: Evidence complete in Documents/fj40-dispute. Next: written demand, then MI Dept of State complaint against broker license D001231. eBay recourse is dead.

items.title: Electrical gremlin hunt
items.note: Ballast resistor was a red herring (original ~1.6 ohm Toyota unit is correct). Keep the fuel pump swap in mind as the last known change.
